newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTP bull run to contiune, aim for 134.53.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTP bull run to contiune, aim for 134.53.

text.p: September BTPs will continue their bull run on Wednesday and will aim for trendline resistance at 134.53 ahead of 134.70, technical analysts said.
They said overbought signals on the short term Relative Strength Index were overshadowed by a more positive outlook from longer term momentum indicators.

"We saw a classic break through the upside on Tuesday so the potential is to go to 134.22 ahead of 134.53 then 134.70 trendline resistances," said Hans-Guenter Redeker, technical analyst at Chase in London.
By 0751 GMT, September BTPs were up 0.25 at 134.25.
The contract forged a new all-time high at 134.38 in early trade, picking up from Tuesday's impressive push up.
The 14-day RSI was at 73.0 percent in early trade indicating the market was overbought, but Redeker noted other longer-term momentum indicators told a different story.

"You could say there is a slight negative divergence on the short term RSI which would call for some corrective activity," said Redeker. "But other momentum indicators that are more long term oriented draw a different picutre."
"For example the nine-week RSI has just broken out of a downward trend channel...and has plenty of upside potential."
Analysts at one European bank said a bullish triangle formation on hourly charts was triggered after Tuesday's move higher, leaving a price objective at 134.60 for Wednesday.
"The longer term objective will be at 135.20 which is the 100 percent projection of the movement from 131.90 to 128.60," they said in a note.
The analysts put a band of good support between 133.60 and 133.40.
By 0820 GMT, September Eurolira was up one basis point at 93.51.
